Acceptance_Letter: 1. Pull open hands to chest (Accept), 2. Mime stamp/rectangle with thumb on palm (Letter).
Good_Morning: 1. Thumbs-up moving forward (Good), 2. Flat hand rises upward like the sun (Morning).
Good_Afternoon: 1. Thumbs-up moving forward (Good), 2. Bent arm pointing straight up at 12 o'clock (Afternoon).
Good_Evening: 1. Thumbs-up moving forward (Good), 2. Arm curves downward like setting sun (Evening).
Good_Night: 1. Thumbs-up moving forward (Good), 2. Both wrists cross downward at chest (Night).
Excuse_Me: Slide fingertips across flat upturned palm of opposite hand twice politely.
Nice_to_Meet_You: 1. Flat hand strokes chin (Nice), 2. Both index fingers come together and tap (Meet).
Invite_Welcome: Both open palms facing upward and swept gently inward towards body.
Ask_Question: Point index finger forward and curl it into a question mark shape.
Call_Phone: Make phone handshape ('Y' shape: thumb at ear, pinky at mouth) tilted towards ear.
Break_Pause_Time_out: Place flat horizontal palm on top of vertical fingertips forming a 'T' shape (Time out).
Aadhar_Card: 1. Press thumb onto palm (thumbprint), 2. Outline rectangle with thumbs and index fingers (Card).
Identity_Card: 1. Pinky finger points at chest badge ('I'), 2. Outline rectangular ID card shape.
Credit_Card: Swipe side of right hand through curled left palm like swiping a card through machine.
Book_Tickets: 1. Open joined palms like book, 2. Mime tearing/holding small ticket slip between fingers.
Ticket_Counter: 1. Mime holding small ticket slip, 2. Flat hands trace flat counter table surface.
Police_Station: 1. Two fingers salute forehead (Police), 2. Fingertips meet forming triangular roof (Station).
Fast_Food: 1. Hands flick rapidly forward (Fast), 2. Fingertip cluster taps repeatedly at mouth (Food).
Bank_Account_Number: 1. Count coins into palm (Bank), 2. Tap fingers sequentially like entering digits (Number).
Covering_Letter: 1. Spread flat palm covering top of other hand, 2. Mime folding paper into envelope (Letter).
All_the_best_Good_luck: Thumbs-up raised with encouraging forward push (Good luck / All the best).
Hurry_Up_Quickly: Rapidly flick open hands forward and inward repeatedly indicating fast motion.
Railway_Station: 1. Two fingers mime train wheels moving on track, 2. Hands form triangular roof peak (Station).
Bus_Stop: 1. Mime holding bus steering wheel, 2. Open flat palm held out firmly indicating stop.
AC_Express_Train: 1. Mime cool air waving at chest (AC), 2. Train wheels rolling rapidly forward (Express).
Bullet_Train: 1. Pointed finger rockets forward like bullet speed, 2. Hands rolling like train wheels.
Local_Train: 1. Index finger taps down locally, 2. Arms cycle forward like train wheels.
Domestic_Flight: 1. Flat hand mimes airplane inside national boundary, 2. Wings gliding smoothly forward.
International_Flight: 1. Curled hands trace globe circle, 2. Airplane handshape ascends upward into sky.
Boarding_Pass: 1. Mime airplane wings flying, 2. Hold flat paper card with two fingers showing pass.
First_Aid: 1. Thumb and index mime cross on opposite arm, 2. Flat hands open offering help/care.
Ambulance_Care_Assistant: 1. Hand gestures rotating siren light above head, 2. Caring hands support opposite wrist.
Blood_Bank: 1. Pinch and draw red drop from fingertip (Blood), 2. Mime depositing into counter vault (Bank).
Blood_Group: 1. Pinch red drop from fingertip (Blood), 2. Hands form circular group boundary cluster.
Blood_pressure: 1. Wrap imaginary cuff around upper arm, 2. Squeeze pump bulb repeatedly with fist.
Medical_Certificate: 1. Stethoscope gesture at chest (Medical), 2. Hands open flat unrolling official certificate.
Birth_Certificate: 1. Cradle arms rocking newborn baby (Birth), 2. Open flat document paper (Certificate).
Death_Certificate: 1. Palms turn from face-up to face-down (Passing), 2. Open flat official paper.
Income_Certificate: 1. Count notes/money into palm (Income), 2. Display flat rectangular certificate sheet.
Fitness_Certificate: 1. Flex biceps with fists showing physical strength, 2. Display flat certificate paper.
Fire_Station: 1. Wiggle fingers upward like rising flames (Fire), 2. Fingertips meet at triangular roof peak.
Customer_Care: 1. Mime person pointing, 2. Two open hands held gently together offering care and support.
Shopping_Cart: 1. Both hands grip imaginary cart handle, 2. Push cart forward smoothly while walking.
Voter_ID_card: 1. Press ink stamp onto index finger (Vote), 2. Outline rectangular ID card badge.
Key_Card: 1. Twist key in lock motion, 2. Trace rectangular plastic card with index and thumb.
Memory_Card: 1. Touch temple with index finger (Memory), 2. Pinch small micro-card between index & thumb.
Debit_Card: Swipe edge of flat hand through curled palm of other hand (electronic card swipe).
Bottled_water: 1. Hand grips cylindrical bottle, 2. Finger taps chin indicating drinking water.
Drinking_Water: Index finger tilted and taps twice at lips indicating water to drink.
Water_Purifier: 1. Water gesture at chin, 2. Flat hands filter downward showing pure clear stream.
Water_tap: Thumb and fingers turn imaginary water tap knob clockwise twice.
Junk_Food: 1. Wave hand dismissively (Junk), 2. Fingertips tap mouth repeatedly (Food).
Food_Poisoning: 1. Fingertips tap at mouth (Food), 2. Hand clenches stomach with uncomfortable expression.
Room_Service: 1. Trace 4 square walls of room, 2. Flat upturned palm carries tray forward (Service).
Fitting_Room: 1. Pull shirt collar checking size fit, 2. Trace rectangular enclosure of room.
Cold_Room: 1. Cross arms shivering with clenched fists (Cold), 2. Trace 4 walls of room enclosure.
Front_office: 1. Open hand gestures toward front, 2. Flat hands type on desk surface (Office).
Back_office: 1. Thumb points over shoulder behind (Back), 2. Mime paperwork typing at desk (Office).
Part_Time_Job: 1. Cut horizontal palm in half with edge of other hand (Part), 2. Fists hammer work gesture.
Full_Time: 1. Open circle swept with flat palm covering entire clock, 2. Fists tap wrist watch.
Public_Holiday: 1. Hands open wide indicating all people/public, 2. Thumbs hooked in armpits resting (Holiday).
Daily_Everyday: Thumb knuckle strokes cheek forward repeatedly indicating every single day.
Next_Day: Index finger curves up and lands forward indicating tomorrow / the next day.
Close_friend: 1. Both index fingers hooked tightly together (Close), 2. Warm smile with chest tap (Friend).
Clean_Tidy: Flat palm sweeps across other flat palm wiping it completely spotless and clean.
Earbuds_Earphones_Headphones: Insert index fingertips into ear canals or cup both ears with curved palms.
Charger_Phone: 1. Two prongs of fingers plug into wall socket, 2. Phone shape tilted at ear.
Electric_Car: 1. Touch bent index fingers together like electric spark, 2. Turn imaginary steering wheel.
Electric_Bus: 1. Touch index fingers together like electric current, 2. Grip large bus steering wheel.
Car_Wash: 1. Hands turn steering wheel (Car), 2. Circular wiping motions with both open palms (Wash).
